draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 148th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 11th of 21 at S. He went 163rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: George Odum. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (80th percentile), broad jump (90th percentile). College production: 40 tackles in 2020, 15th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers (reserve). 40 career games and 17 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2024 against a career-best 5 in 2022. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (11th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 6.8% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, below the norm.
